observations: Drivers should obey legal speed limits and following-distance and lane-use rules.
Drivers should not use a mobile phone while the vehicle is moving.
Every occupant should use a seat belt on short and long journeys.
Drivers should not enter traffic tired or sleep-deprived and should take periodic breaks.
Pedestrian priority, work-zone directions and calm road conduct remain part of safe driving.
limitations: The page is general public guidance, not vehicle-specific training or a substitute for current traffic law.
